facts.text: Serve the cocoa when Judy the elf makes Scott a cup.
facts.why: Judy only brings the pyjamas and leaves. A different elf then offers Scott cocoa made to his own recipe over 1,200 years.
facts.fix: Serve the cocoa when an elf brings Scott a cup of his own recipe.

facts.why: The cocoa is brought by another elf after Judy has left with the pyjamas, not made by Judy.

facts.text: Dad, you're Santa now, so you have to eat all the cookies. That's the rule, and I'm helping.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Charlie's words, but it is not a line from the film. Charlie keeps his dad's secret and believes he is Santa.
facts.fix: Dad, you're Santa now, so eat the cookies. Mum and Neil don't need to know yet.

fix_note.text: Dad, you're Santa now, so eat the cookies. Mum and Neil don't need to know yet.
